newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nichiboshin bid-only on restructure plan approval.
newsitem.headline: Nichiboshin bid-only on restructure plan approval.

text.p: Nichiboshin Ltd shares were bid-only in Tuesday morning trade, after the agricultural financial institutions among its creditors told it they would accept Nichiboshin's restructuring plan, brokers said.
As of 0132 GMT, the non-bank financial institution's shares were bid-only at 250 yen, after closing at 215 yen the day before.

Financial bodies belonging to the National Mutual Insurance Federation of Agricultural Cooperatives and the national body itself told Nichiboshin that they would accept the non-bank's five year restructuring plan, an official of National Mutual said.
Nichiboshin did not comment on its other creditors.
